resolvedFindings.title: Preserve each retained sort's week when adding an identity sort
resolvedFindings.reason: onSort clears the shared sortWeek and sortTrendId whenever Player or Marker is clicked, even when Shift preserves the existing primary metric sort. PositionSection then reads every retained metric from the last displayed week rather than the explicitly sorted week. Retained trend sorts similarly lose their block identity.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Display Weeks 1 and 2 with Alpha/Beta each scoring 30 in Week 1 and 5/20 in Week 2. Click Sort Week 1 Fantasy points, then Shift-click Sort Player.
resolvedFindings.expected: Week 1 fantasy points remains the descending primary sort; the equal values are broken by ascending name, giving Alpha, Beta.
resolvedFindings.actual: Prefs retain fantasy_points descending followed by player ascending, but sortWeek becomes null and rows become Beta, Alpha according to Week 2 points.
resolvedFindings.recommendation: Store the week/block context with each sort descriptor, or at minimum preserve the existing metric context when adding identity tie-breakers. Reconcile retained contexts when their week or trend block is removed.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Root implemented correction during review; independently reproduced original failure and verified the corrected desired behavior.

resolvedFindings.title: Derive historical ESPN changes from consecutive observations
resolvedFindings.reason: The newly selectable rosterDelta chart reads row.rosterDelta directly from stored history, while the server's historical rows contain the source rosterPct fields and only the current response rows receive a calculated delta. Browser merging computes the current delta but does not reconstruct earlier raw-history deltas. Thus existing persisted/server history can contain ample real observations while the new metric reports them as missing.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Load three ESPN history observations for the same player with rosterPct 10, 20 and 15, and a current row rosterDelta of -5; open Market history and select Roster change pp.
resolvedFindings.expected: First change is unavailable; the next changes are +10 and -5 percentage points, with signed bars and the common source-wide delta scale.
resolvedFindings.actual: Exact observations are unavailable, unavailable, -5 and the chart is replaced by History starts here despite three real observations. Reproduced through the normal component fetch/save path with IndexedDB enabled.
resolvedFindings.recommendation: Calculate deltas per player from consecutive full provider observations before applying the selected count, preserving null whenever either observation lacks rosterPct; use the same derived histories for scale and displayed values.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Root implemented correction during review; independently reproduced original failure and verified the corrected desired behavior.
